description: Best-price quote and ready-to-sign transaction for a token swap on Solana, routed through the Jupiter meta-aggregator (RFQ market makers plus every major DEX). Give input and output as symbols (SOL, USDC, USDT, JUP, JitoSOL, mSOL, BONK, WIF, RAY, PYTH, ETH) or mint addresses, and the amount in human units. Without taker you get the quote; with taker you also get the unsigned base64 transaction that the wallet signs itself and lands through /solana/swap/execute. Non-custodial. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

amount.description: Amount to sell in human units, e.g. 0.5 (or use amount_raw)

amount_raw.description: Amount to sell in base units (lamports, micro-USDC...)

input.description: Token to sell: symbol or mint address

output.description: Token to buy: symbol or mint address

receiver.description: Wallet that receives the output token (default taker)

slippage_bps.description: Max slippage in basis points, 0-5000 (default: Jupiter's live estimate)

taker.description: Wallet that signs and pays; omit for a quote only
